name: FiniteGraph
explanation: Defines a finite graph consisting of a finset of vertices, a finset of edges, and a proof validity condition ensuring that every edge connects two valid vertices.

name: FiniteGraph.Adj
explanation: Adjacency predicate stating that two vertices u and v are adjacent if the pair (u, v) is in the graph's edge set.

name: FiniteGraph.getN1Finset
explanation: Computes the set of out-neighbors (N1) for a given vertex u by filtering the edges originating from u and mapping them to their destination.

name: FiniteGraph.cardN1
explanation: Calculates the out-degree (cardinality of N1) of a vertex u.

name: FiniteGraph.getN2Finset
explanation: Computes the second-stage neighborhood (N2) of a vertex u, consisting of vertices reachable in two steps that are not u itself and not in N1(u).

name: FiniteGraph.cardN2
explanation: Calculates the size of the second-stage neighborhood (N2) for a vertex u.

name: FiniteGraph.isSeymour
explanation: Boolean check for whether a vertex u satisfies Seymour's condition (i.e., |N2(u)| ≥ |N1(u)|).

name: FiniteGraph.isNonSeymour
explanation: Boolean check for whether a vertex u fails Seymour's condition (i.e., |N2(u)| < |N1(u)|).

name: FiniteGraph.IsIrreflexive
explanation: Property stating that no vertex has a self-loop (no vertex is adjacent to itself).

name: FiniteGraph.IsAntisymmetric
explanation: Property stating that the graph contains no 2-cycles (if u is adjacent to v and v is adjacent to u, then u must equal v).

name: FiniteGraph.IsOriented
explanation: Defines an oriented graph as one that is both irreflexive and antisymmetric.

name: FiniteGraph.IsSeymourProp
explanation: Propositional version of Seymour's condition: |N1(u)| ≤ |N2(u)|.

name: FiniteGraph.isSeymour_iff
explanation: Proves that the boolean `isSeymour` function is equivalent to the logical `IsSeymourProp` proposition.

name: GloLex
explanation: Inductive coordinate system (BFS-Lex) representing paths and layer assignments starting from a root vertex through child and same-layer neighbor transitions.

name: GloLex.pathLength
explanation: Computes the path length or distance from the root for a given GloLex path object.

name: GloLex.toVertex
explanation: Extracts the vertex identifier from a GloLex path element.

name: GloLex.toDist
explanation: Extracts the distance layer index from a GloLex path element.

name: Coord
explanation: Abbreviation for a coordinate pair representing (distance, lexId).

name: GLONode
explanation: Represents a node in the graph level order with its distance, lexical ID, various neighbor lists (out, interior, exterior, back), parent, and sequential node number.

name: GLONode.toProd
explanation: Converts a GLONode into a raw product pair of its distance and lex ID.

name: GLONode.toCoords
explanation: Extracts the coordinate pair (dist, lexId) from a GLONode.

name: GLONode.Lt
explanation: Lexicographical strict less-than relation between two GLONodes based on distance first, then lexical ID.

name: defaultGLONode
explanation: Provides a default, zero-initialized GLONode instance.

name: gloNode_lt_wellFounded
explanation: Proves that the GLONode less-than relation (`GLONode.Lt`) is well-founded.

name: GraphLevelOrder
explanation: Represents a graph structured hierarchically into layers of GLONodes under a BFS-Lex traversal, along with delta parameters and max layer limits.

name: GraphLevelOrder.getNode?
explanation: Looks up a GLONode in the graph array matching a given coordinate.

name: GraphLevelOrder.getN1Finset
explanation: Retrieves the out-neighbor finset for a node at a given coordinate in the level order.

name: GraphLevelOrder.cardN1
explanation: Calculates the size of N1 for a node coordinate in the level order.

name: GraphLevelOrder.getN2Finset
explanation: Computes the second-stage neighborhood finset for a node coordinate in the level order.

name: GraphLevelOrder.cardN2
explanation: Calculates the size of N2 for a node coordinate in the level order.

name: GraphLevelOrder.isSeymour
explanation: Boolean check if a coordinate satisfies Seymour's condition within the level-ordered graph.

name: GraphLevelOrder.isNonSeymour
explanation: Boolean check if a coordinate fails Seymour's condition within the level-ordered graph.

name: GraphLevelOrder.IsIrreflexive
explanation: Property stating no node contains its own coordinates in its out-neighbors.

name: GraphLevelOrder.Adj
explanation: Defines a directed arc between two GLONodes by verifying they belong to the graph and v's coordinates are in u's out-neighbors.

name: GraphLevelOrder.IsAntisymmetric
explanation: Property stating that directed arcs are antisymmetric (no 2-cycles between nodes).

name: GraphLevelOrder.IsOriented
explanation: Combined property that the level-ordered graph is both irreflexive and antisymmetric.

name: GraphLevelOrder.CoordUnique
explanation: Property ensuring that node coordinates (dist and lexId) uniquely identify each node in the graph.

name: GraphLevelOrder.getN1Finset_eq
explanation: Proves that looking up N1 for a node's coordinates matches its out-neighbors finset under coordinate uniqueness.

name: GraphLevelOrder.cardN1_eq
explanation: Relates the level-order cardN1 function to the cardinality of the node's out-neighbors finset.

name: GraphLevelOrder.cardN1_eq_length
explanation: Proves cardN1 equals the list length of out-neighbors when list entries have no duplicates.

name: interiorNeighbors
explanation: Computes interior neighbors shared between adjacent nodes u and v residing on consecutive layers.

name: exteriorNeighbors
explanation: Computes exterior neighbors for a forward pair u and v, lying in N2(u) intersected with v's out-neighbors.

name: backNeighbors
explanation: Computes back-neighbors for a forward pair u and v, consisting of v's out-neighbors that point back to earlier layers.

name: interior_neighbors_implies_first_neighbors
explanation: Proves that an interior neighbor of a forward pair belongs to the out-neighbors of both parent u and child v.

name: exterior_neighbor_implies_second_neighbor
explanation: Proves that an exterior neighbor of a forward pair belongs to the second-stage neighborhood N2 of u.

name: distOf
explanation: Retrieves the distance layer of a node given its lexical ID.

name: fwdArc
explanation: Boolean predicate checking if u and v form a valid forward arc where v is exactly one layer after u.

name: IsCounterexample
explanation: Defines a graph counterexample structure with unique coordinates, orientation, non-empty nodes, and where every node violates Seymour's condition.

name: layerInteriorArcCount
explanation: Counts the total interior arcs present across nodes in layer k.

name: getLayerAtDistance
explanation: Extracts the finset of all GLONodes located at a specific distance layer k.

name: neighborhood_density
explanation: Defines neighborhood density at layer k as the ratio of interior arc count to layer size.

name: interiorArcs
explanation: Constructs the finset of directed interior arc pairs connecting u and v to their shared interior neighbors.

name: allInteriorArcs
explanation: Collects all interior arcs across every valid forward pair in the graph.

name: interiorOutDegree
explanation: Calculates the interior out-degree of a coordinate node.

name: interiorInDegree
explanation: Calculates the interior in-degree of a coordinate node.

name: totalInteriorDegree
explanation: Computes the total interior degree (in-degree plus out-degree) for a coordinate node.

name: maxTotalInteriorDegree
explanation: Finds the maximum total interior degree across all nodes in the graph.

name: interiorArcCount
explanation: Computes the total number of interior arcs in the graph.

name: mceMetric
explanation: Defines the lexicographical metric pair (interior arc count, max total interior degree) used to measure minimality for counterexamples.

name: IsMinimumCounterexample
explanation: Defines a minimum counterexample as a counterexample graph that minimizes the MCE metric among all counterexamples.

name: maxInDeg_eq_one_iff_bijective
explanation: Proves that a function has bounded in-degree ≤ 1 for all targets if and only if it is bijective (for finite types).

name: node_out_degree_ge_delta
explanation: Verifies that any valid node in the graph list satisfies the minimum out-degree delta condition.

name: internal_degree_lower_bound
explanation: Proves that a node's out-degree is bounded below by its distance layer index i.

name: interior_degree_rigidity
explanation: Proves by trichotomy that an interior neighbor count must equal its distance layer k under upper and lower bound constraints.

name: node_interior_degree_eq_k
explanation: Specialized theorem enforcing that a node's interior degree equals its layer index k using omega.

name: ConnectedBack
explanation: Predicate stating two nodes u and v are connected by a back-path if a back-neighbor of v is also an out-neighbor of u.

name: NoConnectedBack
explanation: Property stating that no forward arc coexists with a connected back-arc structure.

name: IsRoot
explanation: Defines the root node as an existing node that is strictly less than all other nodes in the graph under GLONode.Lt.

name: root_unique
explanation: Proves that the root node is unique.

name: root_dist_zero
explanation: Proves that the root node must sit at distance layer 0, assuming layer 0 is non-empty.

name: layer_bound_of_step
explanation: Derives a layer size upper bound formula given a step decrement function.

name: degree_formula_under_no_back_arcs
explanation: Establishes the size formula for graph layers under the assumption of no back arcs.

name: layerIds
explanation: Extracts the finset of lexical IDs for nodes at a given distance layer j.

name: layerCoords
explanation: Extracts the finset of coordinates for nodes at a given distance layer j.

name: BFSWF
explanation: Defines BFS well-formedness, ensuring every out-neighbor has a corresponding node in the graph and its distance increases by at most 1.

name: fwdArc_spec
explanation: Specification equivalence for `fwdArc` detailing node membership, adjacency, and the strict +1 layer distance.

name: exteriorNeighbors_subset_layer
explanation: Proves that the exterior neighbors of a forward arc are subset-contained within the subsequent layer coordinates.

name: IsMinOutDeg
explanation: Defines the minimum out-degree property for a finite graph.

name: NoBackArcs
explanation: Property stating that back-neighbors are empty for all node pairs.

name: interior_lower_bound
explanation: Arithmetic lower bound constraint establishing that interior neighbor count is at least k + 1.

name: back_ge_deficiency
explanation: Proves that interior deficiencies force back-arcs.

name: too_few_interior
explanation: Proves that having too few interior neighbors guarantees positive back-arcs.

name: layers_disjoint
explanation: Proves that nodes residing at different distance layers cannot be equal.

name: layerCoords_disjoint
explanation: Proves that coordinate sets of distinct layers are disjoint.

name: PartitionWF
explanation: Well-formedness partition condition requiring a node's total out-degree length to equal the sum of its back, interior, and exterior neighbor list lengths.

name: child_interior_deficit
explanation: Proves that an interior neighbor deficit forces either positive back or exterior neighbors.

name: out_eq_int_union_ext
explanation: Proves that a child's out-neighbor finset equals the union of interior and exterior neighbors under no back-arcs.

name: int_ext_disjoint
explanation: Proves that interior and exterior neighbor sets are disjoint for a forward pair.

name: extra_forward_arc_produces_seymour_vertex
explanation: Proves that sufficient exterior neighbors force the parent vertex to satisfy Seymour's condition.

name: extra_interior_violates_mce_metric
explanation: Contradiction theorem showing that a smaller MceMetric violates the minimality of a minimum counterexample.

name: int_not_too_low
explanation: Rules out interior counts falling below layer requirements.

name: child_interior_deficit_no_back
explanation: Establishes a degree bound when interior deficit occurs without back-arcs.

name: fewer_interior_implies_extra_forward
explanation: Relates fewer interior neighbors to extra forward structure and Seymour bounds.

name: interior_degree_bounds
explanation: Establishes lower and upper bounds on the cardinality of interior neighbors for a parent vertex.

name: cond_of_nodes
explanation: Helper theorem proving that two nodes in the graph with a +1 distance relationship evaluate the boolean inclusion guard to true.
